summary: The diff extends parse_duration to handle compound durations with units d, h, m, s, ms in strictly descending order, preserves the existing plain-integer fast path, and rejects all specified malformed inputs with ValueError (e.g., empty string, negative numbers, unknown units, repeated units, out-of-order units, missing numbers, whitespace between number and unit). The implementation passes all existing tests (6/6) and adds no public API changes.
